summary: Examples of fetch: default per-host tree, flat with a hostname prefix, flat into a directory, and a path relative to the playbook.
questions: How do I fetch a file from many hosts with unique names?
How do I save a fetched file into a folder next to my playbook?
What path does fetch create by default?

answer_card.title: fetch examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.fetch: {src: /tmp/somefile, dest: /tmp/fetched}
  # -> /tmp/fetched/host.example.com/tmp/somefile
- ansible.builtin.fetch:
    src: /tmp/somefile
    dest: /tmp/prefix-{{ inventory_hostname }}
    flat: yes
- ansible.builtin.fetch: {src: /tmp/uniquefile, dest: /tmp/special/, flat: yes}
- ansible.builtin.fetch:
    src: /tmp/uniquefile
    dest: special/prefix-{{ inventory_hostname }}   # relative to playbook
    flat: yes
```
